evidence.quote: All LLM calls go through your own API key. Choose Anthropic Claude or Google Gemini per provider preference.

checkNote: README: 'All LLM calls go through your own API key. Choose Anthropic Claude or Google Gemini per provider preference.' Default prefs have empty apiKey/geminiApiKey. The release has only Anthropic and Gemini endpoints and no ollama string. The MCP server works without a key but the main chat feature does not. The cited prefs.js line is weak support for localModel, but the answer is right.
